title: How to Survive a Psyop
description: An accessible, progressive decision tree designed to help people experiencing fear, panic or psychological distress make simple, safe decisions. Prioritises immediate safety, reduces impulsive responses and provides additional guidance only when requested. Does not require the reader to determine whether manipulation is occurring.
heroLead: If there is an ongoing situation follow the instructions in What To Do.  If you are here because you think something happened to you in the past, start with the four survival rules, read the intro, or explore the site conversationally with ChatGPT.
